mainEntity.name: What is included in a full bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full bathroom renovation typically includes updating or replacing all major elements. This often involves new flooring, wall finishes, a new vanity and countertop, toilet replacement, and shower or bathtub installation. Plumbing and electrical updates may also be part of the project, especially if the layout is changing or older systems need modernization. The specific scope depends on the existing condition and desired outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full bathroom renovation updates or replaces all major elements, including flooring, walls, vanity, toilet, and shower/tub, with potential plumbing and electrical work.
